structure: The GB notification service prototype (GOV.UK Prototype Kit, Nunjucks views, one Express router) at ~/git/defra/defra-design/GB-notification-service, commit 04a073b (the checkout's HEAD is 04a073b, so files can be read in place; use git show 04a073b:<path> if it has moved). Design Release 2.1 is not a separate app: app/lib/design-release-2.1-version.js (42 lines) calls app/lib/version-mount.js (363 lines), which copies every route in app/routes.js under /design-release-2.1, keeps a separate session nest (_designRelease21, flag _isDesignRelease21Version), prefixes journey paths in redirects and render data, sets service-navigation hrefs, and renders app/views/design-release-2.1/<view>.html where one exists, otherwise the root view. app/routes.js is 13,114 lines: lines 1-11104 are about 510 helper functions (session, validation, view models, render functions), lines 11105-13102 are about 90 route handlers, lines 13103-13114 mount the versions (DR2.1 before DR2). Handlers branch on isDesignRelease21SessionData and isDesignRelease2SessionData; DR2.1 also sets isDesignRelease2Version, so both DR2 and DR2.1 branches apply under /design-release-2.1. Views in scope: the 39 DR2.1 overrides in app/views/design-release-2.1/ (about 4,500 lines), the 15 DR2.1 partials in app/views/partials/design-release-2.1/ (about 900 lines), the root views DR2.1 falls back on (address-book, address-book-add, address-book-add-usage, address-book-lookup, address-book-view, index; about 880 lines), the root partials the DR2.1 pages include or routes.js renders (notification-status, region-of-origin-code-input, arrival-date-picker, animal-identification-saved-animals, cph-number-input, permanent-address-new-address-fields, the four reason-for-import selects, transporter fields and banner, address-book-manual-address-fields), partials/design-release-2/cancel-amend-modal.html (included by layouts/journey.html), and layouts/main.html and layouts/journey.html. app/data/ holds 34 list files (about 3,900 lines) that routes.js requires. Cut into 16 parts by what a user sees: the shell and journey control, then the journey in page order (start, consignment, reason, identification, arrival and transit, transporter, roles and addresses, CPH and permanent address, documents, review and submit), then notification hub with amend and copy, dashboard, templates, and the address book in two parts. routes.js is too big for one agent, so each part reads the routes.js line ranges that hold its pages' helpers, render functions and handlers; the ranges tile lines 1-13114 with no gaps or overlaps, and a view or partial shared by two parts is read by both but claimed only for the pages the part names. Left out by scope: app/views/intro/ and intro/routes.js, app/views/design-release-2/ and app/views/partials/design-release-2/ (except the one modal journey.html includes), app/views/testing/ and app/lib/testing-version.js and design-release-2-version.js, and the root journey views that DR2.1 overrides. Also left out: app/assets/ (client-side JavaScript and Sass, not named by the scope; the rendered traces source covers client behaviour), and three files nothing in scope reads (app/data/package-types.js, app/data/place-of-origin-addresses.js, app/utils/notification-reference.js, used only by intro/routes.js or not at all).
